newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA INSURES SALE OF 5 SHIPS TO IRAN FOR $79 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CHINA INSURES SALE OF 5 SHIPS TO IRAN FOR $79 MLN.

text.p: The state-owned People's Insurance (Property) Company of China will provide $78.9 million in export credit insurance for the sale of five ships to Iran, the China Daily said on Thursday.

An agreement signed on Wednesday would cover a $130 million contract by China National Aero-Technology Import and Export Corp (CATIC) to export five multi-purpose cargo vessels of 21,000-22,600 deadweight tonnes to the Islamic Republic of Iran Shipping Line, it said.
Built by Guangzhou Shipyard International Co Ltd, the vessels would begin delivery at the start of next year, and the total export fund would be used in six and a half years, it said.
The People's Insurance Company of China has provided $10 billion worth of export credit insurance since it began a pilot export insurance project in 1989, it said.
